description: This file defines the Currency class within the Opencart localization model, providing methods to manipulate and retrieve currency data from the database.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A model class responsible for currency data operations such as editing values, retrieving currency details, and listing all active currencies.

methods.name: editValueByCode
methods.description: Updates the currency value in the database for a given currency code and clears the related cache.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves a currency record from the database based on its currency ID.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCode
methods.description: Fetches active currency details from the database using the currency code.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Returns a list of all active currencies, utilizing caching to optimize performance.
